bio: Picture the scene: You are in the lovely town of Buren, and step into an elegantly converted barn in anticipation of an intimate dinner. You are served dishes that embody a refined modern take on French cuisine. This chef brings a clear culinary vision and deep, expressive flavours, uniting local and international influences. A particular standout: pan-seared cod with asparagus and set egg yolk, crispy pommes dauphine and a rich hollandaise espuma. The appealing à la carte selection and set menu are well worth exploring....
